name: manual.writhing_stalker_hit_fade_mcw
description: Manual playtest handoff: vulnerable midnight writhing-stalker scene with one hostile stalker staged south of the player. The harness only loads the save and audits footing; it sends no gameplay keys after load.

steps.label: post_load_manual_hit_fade_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: manual handoff loads onto the vulnerable midnight stalker footing before the tester advances time

steps.label: audit_manual_hit_fade_midnight
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected midnight time before manual stalker play

steps.label: audit_manual_hit_fade_stalker
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters metadata did not contain the staged writhing stalker

manual_playtest.question: Does the stalker feel like fair dread: pressure, hit/fade, cooldown, and retreat instead of gluey melee or magic beeline?
tester_notes: Move, wait, use light, or retreat naturally.
Watch whether it creates breathing room after burst pressure.
Save if it either feels very good or obviously wrong.
metadata_to_check_after: saved active monster location/hp after manual play

evidence_contract.claim: manual load starts from current staged writhing-stalker footing without harness gameplay input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: manual handoff footing only; gameplay feel comes from tester play after handoff
